scope: VM/user/hash-package guards precede same-thread bounded display/system lease and own-package release marker. Lease is one-shot, <=3600 seconds, loop checks every200ms. Finally releases thread lease. No input injection, process kill, global power plan or product start.
releaseRequirement: Controller must send --release-own-lease and verify released receipt after journey, including failure; it must not leave lease idle until deadline.
